$comment: Controlled vocabulary for the optional `access` field: a coarse summary of how a collection's content (not just its catalogue) can be reached, as stated by the holder. `name` is the only value allowed in data/collections.json. A value is recorded only when the record's own `access_notes` clearly support it; otherwise the field is omitted. `access_notes` remains the fuller, authoritative wording. See DATA_DICTIONARY.md §2 and METHODOLOGY.md §4.

terms.name: open online
terms.definition: The access notes state that the collection (or its published content) is freely accessible online, with no registration or request.

terms.name: partial online
terms.definition: Some content (selected items, excerpts, many but not all recordings) is freely online; the rest requires a visit, a request, or a partner institution.

terms.name: registration required
terms.definition: Full access requires registering an account or going through a registered partner; at most short excerpts are open.

terms.name: on request
terms.definition: Access is by application or request to the holder; the notes do not say it is limited to the holder's premises.

terms.name: on site only
terms.definition: Content is consulted in person (reading room, research visit, by appointment at the holder's premises); nothing substantive is stated to be online yet.

terms.name: restricted
terms.definition: Access is closed or limited to specific people (e.g. by narrator consent, embargo, or community protocol), as stated by the holder.
